description: Context pre-selection: which registered patterns does this task touch? Criteria are generated from contracts/patterns.json (`python3 tools/jev_ask.py sync`). A ranked hint, never a gate.
instructions: A request was filed against S+H, a native SwiftUI Home Assistant app for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad. The repository registers shared patterns, each with one canonical component. Does fixing or building this request involve the pattern "{option}"?

criteria.action-tiles: Action tiles: the one way a tile shows and runs actions: trailing or below discs, the chevron beside them, feedback kinds, availability motion. (components: TileActionStrip, TileActionButtonStyle, TileActionSpec)
criteria.alerts: Alerts and confirmations: how the app asks "are you sure?" and reports a failure: one presenter, one set of words, one role per decision. (components: AlertCopy)
criteria.avatar: Avatar: how a person is drawn as a disc (photo or initials), and how their Home Assistant photo is synced, cached and removed. (components: UKAvatarView, PersonAvatars)
criteria.bedroom-devices: Bedroom devices (wake light, bed sides): the Primary Bedroom's Wake-Light Alarms and bed sides: tiles, sheets, alarm editors, the active alarm and the Tonight/All Nights prompt. (components: BedSideSheet, WakeLightSheet)
criteria.camera-streams: Camera streams: how live camera video is shared, started, stopped and brought back. (components: CameraStreamPool, CameraLiveModel, CameraStreamRetention)
criteria.content-gate: Content gate: how a page waits for its content before showing it. (components: UKContentGateView)
criteria.design-tokens: Design tokens: the one set of spacing, radius, colour, ink, surface and type values every screen draws from. (components: HassTokens)
criteria.dynamic-grid: Dynamic grid: the responsive tile grid. (components: DynamicGridLayout)
criteria.entity-tile: Entity tile: the glass tile used for entity controls. (components: UKGlassTileView)
criteria.floating-actions: Floating actions and filter sheets: page-level floating buttons (Add Task, Add Groceries, Scan Item, recipe/inventory Search, Sort, Filter) and the sort/filter sheets they open. (components: FloatingActionBar, UKFilterSheet)
criteria.header-edge-fade: Header edge fade: how scrolling content meets a page or modal header. (components: HeaderEdgeFade)
criteria.hinge-avoidance: Hinge avoidance: how content stays off the iPhone Duo's hinge band and keeps a readable width on iPad. (components: HingeAvoidance, UKHingedPanes, UKFoldColumns, FoldColumns)
criteria.image-cache: Image cache: how remote images load, cache and update. (components: ImagePipeline, UKCachedImageView)
criteria.image-card: Image card: a tappable card with a remote image, title and subtitle. (components: ImageCard)
criteria.info-box: Info box: a tinted notice with a title and optional message. (components: InfoBox)
criteria.media-remote: Media remote: the media remote sheet (the 3×3 remote grid with power, and the Remote/Apps/Devices/Hue Sync sections) shared by every TV in the house. (components: MediaRemoteSheet)
criteria.modal-sheet: Modal sheet: how web hash modals become native sheets. (components: UKHassModal, ModalTabBar)
criteria.module-list: Module list: inset lists on the wallpaper (direction G, Controls: Lists). (components: UKModuleListView)
criteria.motion: Motion: the shared components that apply the app-wide motion rules. (components: MotionTokens)
criteria.optimistic-actions: Optimistic actions: how a control shows its new value at once and stays honest. (components: OptimisticActions)
criteria.option-picker: Option picker: picking one value from a short list in a sheet. (components: OptionPickerSheet)
criteria.page-backdrop: Page backdrop: the blurred photo of the house behind every page. (components: HouseBackdrop)
criteria.page-indicator: Page indicator: the one page indicator for every paging row and carousel (Food suggestions, the Weather sheet, the hourly rows). (components: PageIndicator)
criteria.resume-lifecycle: Resume lifecycle: the rule that a background and foreground leaves the app exactly as the first launch did, and the census that proves it. (components: ResourceCensus, ResourceCensusProbe, ukPagesByViewport)
criteria.room-device-sheets: Room device sheets: the device sheets opened from room tiles: bathroom fan, air quality (purifier), humidifier, grill. (components: UKBathroomFanSheet, UKAirPurifierSheet)
criteria.room-overview-sheet: Room overview sheet: the room-by-room sheets behind Home's Lights, Climate, Occupancy, Contact Sensors and Air Quality chips, and the room detail they push. (components: RoomOverviewSheet)
criteria.schedule-date-fields: Schedule date fields: date-and-time pickers for schedules. (components: UKScheduleDateFields)
criteria.scroll-fit: Scroll fit: a vertical scroll view scrolls and bounces only when its content is taller than its viewport. (components: UKScrollFit)
criteria.settings-section: Settings section: a settings page's header + description + controls block, and the pieces that go in it. (components: UKSectionBlock)
criteria.state-message: State message: the empty and error state ("No Chores Due", "Unable to Load Recipes"). (components: UKStateMessageView)
criteria.status-pill: Status pill: a read-only labeled value with a toned icon. (components: StatusPill)
criteria.status-rail: Status rail: the horizontal chip row under a page title. (components: UKStatusRail)
criteria.tap-feedback: Tap feedback: the one haptic vocabulary and the failure feedback built on it. (components: TapFeedback, TransientFailure)
criteria.telemetry: Telemetry: how the app measures its own performance. (components: Telemetry)
criteria.thermostat-dial: Thermostat dial: the circular setpoint dial for `climate` entities. (components: ThermostatDial, UKClimateThermostatDial)
criteria.ticker: Ticker label: one line of text that scrolls through its column when it is too wide, instead of truncating. (components: TickerLabel)
criteria.vacuum-sheet: Vacuum sheet: the robot vacuum sheet (map, status, Controls/Rooms/Auto-Clean/Dock/Info tabs, area editor, cleaning report). (components: UKVacuumSheet)
criteria.valetudo-map: Mapped map: decoding and drawing a Mapped map (rooms, walls, robot, dock, paths, areas). (components: UKValetudoMapView, ValetudoMap)
criteria.weather: Weather card and sheet: the Home weather card, its 24-hour carousel and the Weather sheet, plus the logic under them. (components: UKWeatherCardView, UKWeatherSheet, UKWeatherCarouselView)
criteria.scroll-frame-rate: Scroll frame rate: no app refresh-rate request while scrolling (iOS manages it); scroll surfaces report to ScrollActivity. (components: UKScrollRate)
criteria.swipe-row: Swipe row: swipe actions on rows of a plain stack (iOS 18+), the List's on iOS 17. (components: UKSwipeAction)
criteria.check-row: Check row: the one checkable row: a check circle, the text, an optional trailing accessory. (components: CheckRow)
criteria.modal-inventory: Modal inventory: every modal in the app, how it is presented, what it holds, how it behaves in each pose, and the bugs found. (components: UKShellSheet)
criteria.page-base: Page base: the one way a page, a pane or a tab hosts its scrolling body, spaces it, pins a bar under it and gets its ground. (components: UKPageScrollView, UKPageViewController)
criteria.rows: Rows: the one list row: slots for a leading glyph, check or avatar, the text and a trailing accessory or chevron. (components: UKRowView)
